scope: Proposition 5.9 (Independent-model estimates for the weight pieces) of the manuscript “The mean analytic rank of quadratic twists of elliptic curves” (preprints/The-mean-analytic-rank-of-quadratic-twists-of-elliptic-curves-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 006 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 718fcfce4014a878), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 35. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: With the weights and sums Sj,Z(x) defined in Section 4, there is a fixed exponent C5 such that ∥H0(Z)S0,Z(x) − Ax∥2 ≪ k−1 , (5.33) ∥Hj(Z)Sj,Z(x)∥2 ≪ (k2j )C5 δk j (1 ≤ j ≤ J). (5.34) These bounds are uniform in x ∈ X and over the entire range k0 ≤ k ≤ ℓ3/5, with one fixed k0 and one sufficiently large X threshold.
